name: Zotec Partners
desc:
AR Specialist | $43K to $56K  | No Sales Expectations
Company: Zotec Partners
Industry: Healthcare / Medical Billing and Revenue Cycle Management
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 Think of this as detective work for medical bills. You'd spend your day chasing down insurance claims that got rejected or denied, figuring out why, and following up with insurance companies to get them resolved. You'd work through a queue of correspondence, file appeals when needed, and dig into billing documentation to spot what went wrong. It's a lot of phone and email communication with insurance reps, paired with steady behind the scenes problem solving to get claims paid.
assessment: Expect an assessment of typing, data entry speed and accuracy, internet speed
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: AR (accounts receivable) follow-up experience
Preferred Experience: Not specified beyond required experience
Required Skills:
Ability to understand, analyze, and interpret medical billing documentation and data
Strong willingness to learn new technologies and work cross functionally
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Excel
Critical thinking and issue resolution skills
Ability to prioritize workflow and meet deadlines in a high volume environment
Detail oriented, able to work independently and manage multiple projects
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with prior AR follow-up or medical billing experience
Someone comfortable calling and emailing insurance companies to resolve issues
Someone who enjoys detail heavy, problem solving work
Someone who can manage a high volume caseload independently
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone without AR or medical billing background, this is listed as required, not preferred
Anyone who prefers a fully scripted role over one requiring analysis and judgment
Anyone who struggles with high volume, deadline driven workflows
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Accounts receivable
Medical billing
Claims follow-up
Denials and appeals
Insurance verification
Revenue cycle management
Microsoft Excel
Correspondence resolution
Critical thinking
High volume workflow
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.

4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience with AR follow-up or medical claims resolution.
Walk us through how you'd handle a denied claim from start to resolution.
How do you prioritize your workload when you have a high volume of outstanding claims?
Describe a time you had to analyze billing documentation to catch an error.
How comfortable are you communicating with insurance company representatives on a daily basis?
